feature: Prove Claude and Pi Resume After AskHuman

userStories.title: Pin Claude SDK reproducibly
userStories.description: As a provider maintainer, I want the Claude SDK pinned to the exact spike version, so that live evidence is reproducible and cannot silently test a newer SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: The root package.json and packages/providers/package.json dependency values for @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk are both the literal string 0.3.209, with no caret or other range.
bun.lock workspace dependency specifications match both exact manifest values while the resolved Claude SDK package remains 0.3.209 and Pi lockfile packages remain at 0.80.6.
The prescribed exact-pin check fails before the edit and exits zero after it.
bun install --lockfile-only and bun install --frozen-lockfile both exit zero after the manifest and lockfile update.
The diff is limited to the two dependency specifications and their corresponding lockfile metadata; no automatic upgrade to 0.3.261 occurs.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 1 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-resume-spike.md:134-193. Current values are package.json:76, packages/providers/package.json:38, and bun.lock:8,144,269. Keep the required version exact until the spike is resolved.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 1. Files: package.json, packages/providers/package.json, bun.lock. Exact pin 0.3.209; Pi remains 0.80.6.

userStories.title: Test the fail-closed Claude classifier
userStories.description: As an architecture decision owner, I want deterministic Claude evidence classification, so that partial or conflicting observations cannot select a resume protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: A new askhuman-resume-spike.test.ts first asserts that a complete defer round trip beats a working host-abort workaround, a fully proved host-abort path is selected only when defer is unproved, and third-mechanism, environment-failure, and incomplete-model cases are inconclusive.

The new askhuman-resume-spike.ts defines ClaudeProtocol, ClaudeFailureCategory, and ClaudeModelEvidence exactly for the observed host-abort and deferred facts, without any production provider export or any type copied from an SDK.
The intentional stub implementation produces the prescribed behavioral RED result before the minimum decision logic is added.

classifyClaudeModel returns inconclusive when requires_action is observed or a failure category is present, selects tool-deferred-reissue only after every required same-id defer fact passes, otherwise selects host-abort-new-user-message only after every same-session host-abort fact passes.
classifyClaudeVersion returns a protocol only for exactly sonnet and opus with the same non-inconclusive result; all split, duplicate, missing, or partial evidence is inconclusive.

The focused classifier test runs from packages/providers and passes after implementation; temporarily preferring host abort before defer makes the defer-preference test fail, then the restored implementation passes.
packages/providers/package.json registers this test as its own bun test process, and no live model call occurs when the test imports the module.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 2 steps 1-4 and 8 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-resume-spike.md:197-406 and 595-605. Preserve the fail-closed protocol contract at plan lines 85-106. Package test isolation is required by packages/providers/package.json:34.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 2. Files: packages/providers/src/claude/askhuman-resume-spike.ts, packages/providers/src/claude/askhuman-resume-spike.test.ts, packages/providers/package.json. Stub RED then GREEN; mutation preferring host abort failed the defer test then restored.

userStories.title: Build the manual Claude protocol harness
userStories.description: As a spike operator, I want a self-contained live Claude harness for both candidate mechanisms, so that runtime behavior is captured without changing production providers.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/claude/askhuman-resume-spike.ts remains self-contained, imports Claude types and createSdkMcpServer/query/tool from the owning SDK plus z from zod, and uses only Node built-ins and declared provider dependencies so it can be copied unchanged to an isolated 0.3.261 package.

Both host-abort and PreToolUse-defer experiments target only the custom in-process mcp__archon__AskHuman tool, use fresh server instances when required, instruct exactly one AskHuman call, and never wrap or expose AskUserQuestion.

The collector consumes the entire SDK iterator and retains only session identifier, stop/terminal reason, deferred tool id/name, requires_action observation, completion boolean, and generated-marker boolean; it never serializes raw messages or secrets.

The defer experiment proves only matching custom-tool same-id reissue, redacted updatedInput.archonResume delivery exactly once, successful resumed handling, and tool_deferred_unavailable detection; it treats requires_action as a recorded inconclusive third mechanism.

The host-abort experiment verifies a captured session id, same-session resume with a generated answer marker, completion marker, and absence of a reissued AskHuman call before it can classify that workaround.

The harness defaults CLAUDE_SPIKE_MODELS to sonnet,opus, verifies its installed SDK version using Bun.resolveSync and the adjacent manifest, bounds each model experiment to 120 seconds, and serializes failures only as allowed redacted failure categories.
When executed manually it prints exactly one JSON document, exits nonzero for inconclusive protocol evidence, and is guarded by import.meta.main so focused tests do not call a vendor API.
packages/providers/package.json exposes spike:askhuman:claude but does not add it to test, validate, or CI; focused classifier test and provider type-check pass without making a live call.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 2 steps 5-7 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-resume-spike.md:408-593. Reuse the workspace naming boundary at packages/providers/src/claude/native-tools.ts:13-14 and preserve AD-9 at ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md:113-117. userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 3. Files: packages/providers/src/claude/askhuman-resume-spike.ts, packages/providers/package.json. Live host-abort and PreToolUse-defer harness behind import.meta.main; spike:askhuman:claude is manual-only. Classifier tests and provider type-check passed with no live call.

userStories.title: Characterize Pi durable reopen and continue
userStories.description: As an architecture decision owner, I want a real Pi persistence round trip characterized with a faux transport, so that durable resume is proved without calling a vendor API or adding production plumbing.
acceptanceCriteria: A new isolated Bun test creates a real SessionManager transcript ending in an assistant AskHuman tool call with a known tool-use id, then disposes the first AgentSession.

The test reopens the persisted session through SessionManager.open, appends a ToolResultMessage with the matching toolCallId, recreates a real AgentSession, and proves the appended tool result is the tail of session.agent.state.messages.
The test calls session.agent.continue(), not AgentSession.continue(), and a deterministic faux provider receives the matching ToolResultMessage as the final context message.
The continuation assistant message is persisted and remains present after a second SessionManager.open call.
Only the external model transport is faux; session lifecycle, persistence, disposal, reopening, and continuation use real Pi SDK objects, and the test makes no vendor API request.
Cleanup removes only the verified temporary test directory, and the focused test is registered as its own process in packages/providers/package.json.
Changing the persisted answer toolCallId to a different literal makes a focused assertion fail; restoring the matching id makes the characterization test and provider type-check pass.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 3 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-resume-spike.md:609-836. Pi's current persisted-session seam is packages/providers/src/community/pi/session-resolver.ts:47-73; bridgeSession disposes sessions at packages/providers/src/community/pi/event-bridge.ts:362-378. Tests are runtime proof because packages/providers/tsconfig.json:6-8 excludes test files.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 4. Files: packages/providers/src/community/pi/askhuman-resume.characterization.test.ts, packages/providers/package.json. Real SessionManager dispose/reopen/append/continue with faux transport only. Mismatch toolCallId failed the focused assertion; restored matching id and type-check passed.

userStories.title: Record exact 0.3.209 Claude evidence
userStories.description: As a spike operator, I want redacted evidence from the required Claude SDK version, so that AD-6 depends on observed runtime behavior rather than declarations or a newer comparison package.
acceptanceCriteria: The manual spike command runs the completed harness with ambient authentication, CLAUDE_SPIKE_MODELS=sonnet,opus, and EXPECTED_CLAUDE_SDK_VERSION=0.3.209, writing its single JSON document to the prescribed 6-1-claude-0.3.209.json evidence path.

The evidence file is valid JSON with schemaVersion 1, sdkVersion 0.3.209, exactly sonnet and opus model records, and a protocol value of tool-deferred-reissue, host-abort-new-user-message, or inconclusive.

The evidence contains only allowed metadata, counts, booleans, session identifiers, stop reasons, and redacted failure categories; the plan's rg secrecy check finds no credentials, tokens, prompts, answer payloads, transcript text, or environment values.
The evidence records both candidate mechanisms for each model and the protocol is selected only by the fail-closed classifier.

If authentication, access, timeout, requires_action, unavailable-tool, split-model, or partial observations prevent proof, the saved evidence remains valid and redacted with protocol inconclusive; the required manifest version is not upgraded or relaxed.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 4 steps 1-2 at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-resume-spike.md:840-874 and the evidence contract at plan lines 81-114. This is a manually invoked harness only; do not put it in CI or the ordinary provider test script.

acceptanceCriteria: The self-contained harness is copied to a validated temporary directory, run there with exact @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.261 and zod@4.4.3, and the temporary directory is removed only after an explicit non-root safety check.
The comparison writes valid 6-1-claude-0.3.261.json evidence with schemaVersion 1, sdkVersion 0.3.261, exactly sonnet and opus records, and an allowed protocol value including inconclusive.
The plan's secrecy scan finds no credentials, tokens, prompt text, answer values, transcript text, or environment values in the comparison evidence.

Both evidence top-level protocols are compared and recorded according to the version policy: a 0.3.261 result is comparison evidence only and cannot override an inconclusive 0.3.209 result, relax the exact manifest pin, or authorize an automatic dependency upgrade.
The committed repository dependency manifests and bun.lock remain on exact Claude SDK 0.3.209 after the isolated comparison.

userStories.title: Write outcome and reconcile architecture
userStories.description: As a feature owner, I want one evidence-backed architecture outcome, so that AD-6, diagrams, and sprint status state one truthful provider protocol or an explicit block.
acceptanceCriteria: The Story 6.1 outcome Markdown exists with the exact required section order and cites both repository-relative Claude evidence JSON files plus the actual focused Pi test command.

The outcome states one and only one Claude decision: AMEND for complete custom-tool defer reissue, CONFIRM for complete host abort/new-user-message, or INCONCLUSIVE with Story 6.3 blocked; it never copies prompts, answers, transcripts, credentials, or environment data.

When Pi passes, the outcome records the proved SessionManager.open -> appendMessage(ToolResultMessage) -> createAgentSession -> session.agent.continue() order; when it does not, it uses the prescribed Pi inconclusive statement and blocks Story 6.3.

The AskUserQuestion section always rejects the built-in tool as a product channel while allowing the selected hook mechanism only on custom mcp__archon__AskHuman, and the version section identifies exact 0.3.209 without calling a caret range pinned.

ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md changes only the AD-6, Claude-version, and deferred-spike material necessary to reflect evidence, leaves review-version-reality.md unchanged, and never preserves two active Claude protocols.
architecture-diagrams.md removes unsupported VERIFIED claims and names only the selected protocol and Pi durable order, or INCONCLUSIVE — Story 6.3 blocked for a failed provider gate.

sprint-status.yaml is updated in its existing timestamp format but remains in-progress until final validation proves every completion-gate condition; it is never marked done merely because files or type checks exist.

userStories.title: Validate the spike and apply the final gate
userStories.description: As a release reviewer, I want all focused and repository validation run before the Story 6.1 state is finalized, so that Story 6.3 is unblocked only by complete evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Both focused provider tests pass from packages/providers: the Claude classifier test and the Pi durable-reopen characterization test.
The complete packages/providers test script and packages/providers type-check both pass, with each newly added provider test still invoked in its own Bun process.
bun run validate passes, and the Claude live harness is absent from that command, CI, and the ordinary provider test script.
Both Claude evidence files exist, are valid and redacted, git diff --check passes, and git status is limited to the plan File Map plus the Ralph planning artifacts.

The acceptance audit confirms exact 0.3.209 manifests/lockfile, custom AskHuman-only experiments, real Pi lifecycle evidence, no uncalled resume abstraction, one consistent Claude protocol or explicit inconclusive block, reconciled diagrams, and matching outcome/spine/sprint state.

If every Completion Gate condition, including conclusive 0.3.209 evidence and Pi proof, passes, sprint-status.yaml records epic-6: in-progress and 6-1-prove-claude-and-pi-can-resume-after-askhuman: done.

If any Completion Gate condition is false, sprint-status.yaml retains that Story 6.1 key as in-progress, the outcome remains INCONCLUSIVE, and Story 6.3 remains explicitly blocked; no production HITL feature is added to force completion.
